[[Claws of the Broodmother]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[dagger]]s dropped by the [[Rekoff Broodmother]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Riven Earth]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Poison]] duration on foes by 33% (Stacking)
:Health +30
